info.title: Evakuators.am — Live dispatch API
info.description:
Driver app, operator console and public live search. All paths are under
`/api/v1`. Errors are `{ code, message, details? }` where `code` is one of
`ErrorCode` — clients branch on `code`, never on `message` (Armenian text).

**Idempotency.** Every mutation marked `Idempotency-Key: required` must carry
a client-generated key (8–128 chars `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`). Repeating the same
key with the same body returns the original result (header
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different body returns
`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.

**Optimistic concurrency.** Operator mutations carry `expectedVersion`;
a stale one returns `VERSION_CONFLICT` with `details.currentVersion`.

**Time.** All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. Countdown = `expiresAt − serverTime`
from the same response, never the device clock.

driverApp.description: App token from POST /driver-app/sessions (aud driver:app, bound to a revocable device session). The website's driver token is NOT accepted.

ops.description: Admin-panel session token (POST /admin-auth/login, 2FA if linked). Role ADMIN or DISPATCHER; settings PATCH requires ADMIN.

Requirements.description: null = not asked yet. Dispatch refuses to start while any is null (or weight unknown) unless an operator recorded an override.

UpdateOrder.description: Any subset of CreateOrder fields. A change to pickup, destination, weight, requirements or pricing is MATERIAL — it bumps termsVersion and revokes a pending offer (the driver is re-offered the new terms).

pickupToDestination.description: Road figures for the description only. null when no destination. `manual` = typed by an operator. Never a straight line.

Availability.description: Six independent facts — never one "online" boolean.

TrackingPolicy.description: A request to the app, not a promise — the OS decides actual delivery.

currentOffer.description: The live offer. Contains NO customer contact. `toPickup.etaSeconds` is null when the road could not be routed — then `straightLineMeters` is set and must be labelled «ուղիղ գծով».

activeOrder.description: The assigned order, WITH customer contact and `allowedActions` (server-computed; the app only renders them).

measuredAt.description: Device clock; tolerated up to 30 s ahead

post.summary: App login — the SAME phone + password as the website; revokes the driver's previous device session

delete.summary: Logout — revokes this session and its push tokens; an active order is NOT cancelled

get.summary: Full state snapshot — call on launch, on every WebSocket (re)connect, and when opened from a push

put.summary: The driver's own switches. Offline during an active order stops NEW offers only.

post.summary: App liveness. Does NOT refresh GPS freshness. Throttled 12/min.
1–50 fixes. Only the newest FRESH fix can become the current position; older ones are history. Throttled 30/min.
Accept. Show success ONLY on 200 — never optimistically.
The app rendered the offer (delivery fact — NOT an acceptance)
CANCEL (asks out — assignment is KEPT until an operator releases it) or PROBLEM

200.description: The driver's own past orders — no customer contact

post.summary: Create (DRAFT). Creating and starting dispatch are separate actions.

get.summary: Order + offers history + current attempt's ranked candidates + audit timeline

200.description: Back to DRAFT; pending offer revoked
Payment status set — independent of completion

post.summary: Progress on the driver's behalf (driver phoned) — audited as ADMIN
The one safe way to take an order from a driver — ends the assignment and optionally restarts the search in ONE transaction
Explicitly accept unknown requirements (audited, with a note ≥ 5 chars)
Offer to a chosen driver. Busy/reserved/inactive/suspended/capability can never be overridden; GPS/online/heartbeat/external-busy only with overrideReason (audited).
Compute pickup → destination road figures (never invented without a destination)
Operator-entered distance when the provider fails — stored and shown as manual

get.summary: Drivers who use the app, with position, fix age/accuracy and availability. Filter by viewport.

200.description: Dispatch suspension toggled (the public profile is unaffected)
Effective settings (defaults merged with stored values)

patch.summary: ADMIN only. Each key range-checked and the combination validated before anything is stored.

200.description: Feature flags + outbox backlog / oldest due / dead letters

post.summary: Live nearest drivers (fresh GPS) + the existing profile-base results as a separate fallback section
post.description:
POST so the visitor's position never reaches access logs. Creates no order, reserves nobody, notifies nobody.
Live items carry NO coordinates — rounded road distance/ETA or a straight line (no time) only.
Throttled 10/min/IP; cached ~60 s per ~110 m cell; separate daily routing budget.
A result is not a reservation (`disclaimer: NOT_A_RESERVATION`).

skipRouting.description: Can only ask for LESS (no road figures)

towTruck.description: The public card (same shape as GET /tow-trucks)

fallback.description: Existing NearestSearchApi minus drivers already listed live
